description: Get the current versions of a business's shareable documents: certificates (ISO 9001 and others), compliance declarations (RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals), safety data sheets, data sheets and test reports. Filter by part number and/or document type. Returns version, issue and expiry dates, and a download link that works for 15 minutes. Without business_id or business it lists the documents of every business the user has, grouped by business.

business.description: Name of the business as it appears in list_my_businesses. Used only when business_id is not given. Leave both out when the user has one business, or to search every business the user has.

business_id.description: The business id exactly as given by list_my_businesses (for example yyigsmj5b7mcwxe7). Preferred: use it whenever you know it.

document_type.description: Document types wanted, e.g. 'ISO 9001, RoHS'. Optional; leave out to list all.

part_number.description: Part, model or article number, e.g. A-200. Optional.

name: get_documents
title: Get documents
